source: Transcribed from print PDFs in Card/Print (Green Card Deck with Base Card.pdf, Orange Card.pdf, Red Card Final.pdf, End Game Card.pdf). Print files are treated as authoritative over Master Hub docs and Green.xlsx where they conflict.
statusLegend: confirmed = printed on the physical card
unknown = visible but not mechanically defined

green.name: Green Deck - Terrain & Economy
green.backArt: Wooden shield with green gem, forest background (page 1)

cards.title: Grassland
cards.effectText: +1 Brick Production. Connect this tile with base tile to activate production.
cards.notes: Green.xlsx says 9 copies; print PDF contains 10 (pages 2-11).

cards.title: River
cards.effectText: +1 Brick Production. Connect this tile with base tile to activate production.
cards.notes: Wood bridge icon indicates crossing requirement (per Hub P1: Wood Bridge required to cross River).

cards.title: Valley
cards.effectText: +1 Brick Production. Connect this tile with base tile to activate production.
cards.scopeText: Require a metal bridge to cross

cards.title: Wild Animals
cards.effectText: -1 Brick on hand for every turn you are on this tile or beside this tile without a wall
cards.notes: 4 artworks across 5 copies (wolves, apes, leopards, crocodiles, hippos). Creator ruling 2026-07-14: wording variants ('-1 Brick on hand' vs '-1 Brick Production') stay as printed for now - play with them as-is. Leopard copy missing the down-arrow badge (cosmetic).

cards.title: Nomad Tribe
cards.effectText: Pay 1 > Get 2 next turn. Invest 1 brick to the tribe to get 2 in the next turn. Stand to activate.
cards.notes: 3 art/text variants: 'river tribe', 'forest tribe', 'guardian tribe'. Hub P1 adds: removed if attacked by Red (not printed on card).

cards.title: Trading Post
cards.effectText: On this tile, you may trade with bank or player. Exchange rate: 2 Bricks = 1 Supply.
cards.scopeText: Only 1 player may stand on this tile

cards.title: Ancient Grove
cards.effectText: Produces 2 Bricks if connected to 2 Green Tiles
cards.scopeText: Produce 0 Bricks if requirement not met

cards.title: Fertile Valley
cards.effectText: Produces 2 Bricks if connected to >=1 Valley
cards.scopeText: Produce 0 Bricks if not connected to Valley
cards.notes: Creator ruling 2026-07-14: follow the card - produces 2 if connected to >=1 Valley, else 0. Hub P1's '1 + 1 bonus' wording is outdated.

cards.title: Trade Lock
cards.effectText: Trading Post cannot be used until the start of your next turn. No conversions. No player-to-player trades.
cards.scopeText: This is an action card, do not put this on the map.

cards.title: Market Boost
cards.effectText: Until the start of your next turn, ALL Trading Post exchange rate becomes 1 Brick = 1 Supply
cards.scopeText: This is an action card, do not put this on the map.

baseCards.title: Base Card
baseCards.notes: 4 homestead art variants x2 each (pages 49-56). Title printed upright and rotated 180deg. Page 57 is the Base Card back (parchment panel with mixed terrain border). Base = origin/HQ/command hub per Tone.docx.

orange.name: Orange Deck - Crisis Layer
orange.backArt: Wooden shield, crossed hammers, flaming orange gem (page 1)

cards.title: Hazardous Opportunity
cards.effectText: Gain 2 resources; Select 1 structure to lose 1 durability
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Lost Time

cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Stalled Orders

cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Frozen Moment

cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Resource Toll
cards.effectText: Pay 2 of ANY resources
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Heavy Tariff
cards.effectText: Pay 2 resources or GO BACK 1 hex tile
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Thin Margins
cards.effectText: Discard 1 of any resource
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU & bridges beside

cards.title: Structural Fatigue

cards.scopeText: This card only affects bridges on your tile

cards.title: Emergency Repairs

cards.scopeText: This card only affects bridges beside your tile

cards.title: Pressure Surge

cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Breach Warning

cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Cautious Advance

cards.scopeText: This card affects everyone on this tile

cards.title: Forced Pause

cards.scopeText: Select 2 other teams to pause together

cards.title: Divided Focus
cards.effectText: Choose: Trade OR Move this turn
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Competing Priorities
cards.effectText: Choose: Trade OR Move this turn
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Operational Drag

cards.scopeText: This card affects 2 teams after you

cards.title: Miscommunication
cards.effectText: Reveal your resources and discard 1 resource
cards.scopeText: Select a team of your choice including yourself

cards.title: Narrow Passage
cards.effectText: Pay 2 resources to pass or stop on this tile
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU
cards.notes: Has action-card footer but reads as terrain; icon labels missing on print.

cards.title: Final Warning
cards.effectText: Pay 2 metal OR retreat 1 hex
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Dust Plains
cards.effectText: Build here costs +1 resource
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU
cards.notes: Has action-card footer but reads as terrain - confirm placement rule.

cards.title: Flooded Lowland
cards.effectText: Bridges here lose 1 durability at end of each round
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects bridges built here

cards.title: Supply Chokepoint
cards.effectText: Bridges here lose 1 durability at end of each round
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects bridges built here
cards.notes: Creator ruling 2026-07-14: leave as printed for now (effect matches OR21 despite Choice/Global icons). Revisit after playtesting.

cards.title: Bureaucratic District
cards.effectText: First action taken here each turn costs 2 actions
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects all teams entering this tile

cards.title: Fragile Ridge
cards.effectText: If you end your turn here, lose 1 durability for ALL infrastructures
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects ALL structures built here

cards.title: Overgrown Route
cards.effectText: Pay 1 resource to move out of this tile
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects all teams on this tile

cards.title: Industrial Smog Zone
cards.effectText: Gain 1 resource on entry; adjacent walls lose 1 durability
cards.scopeText: This card affects ALL adjacent walls

cards.title: Cracked Foundation
cards.effectText: Build and Upgrade here cost +1 resource
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects all structures
cards.notes: Creator ruling 2026-07-14: badge should read '-1' (pay 1 extra); printed effect text stands. Fix badge art in next print run.

cards.title: Unstable Ground
cards.effectText: No Build actions may be taken here this round
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects ONLY the round it is placed

cards.title: Trade Jam
cards.effectText: All Teams may not use Trade Tiles this turn
cards.scopeText: Terrain effect activates when any team enters

cards.title: Market Drag
cards.effectText: Trades while on this tile cost +1 resource
cards.scopeText: This terrain allows trade with extra cost
cards.notes: Creator ruling 2026-07-14: '-1' badge is correct (pay 1 extra per trade); printed effect text stands.

cards.title: Uneasy Truce
cards.effectText: Teams on this tile may not Trade this turn
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects teams on this tile

cards.title: Extraction Site
cards.effectText: Gain 2 resources; lose 1 durability on all adjacent infrastructure
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects ONLY the team entering

cards.title: Emergency Contract
cards.effectText: Gain 2 Supply; lose 1 action next round
cards.scopeText: Card activates when team places this tile

cards.title: Risky Expansion
cards.effectText: Build here costs -1 Supply; all adjacent bridges lose 1 durability
cards.scopeText: Card activates when team places this tile

cards.title: Short-Term Boom
cards.effectText: Production here +2 Bricks this round; -1 Brick next round
cards.scopeText: This card only affects ONE team

cards.title: Political Favor
cards.effectText: Ignore 1 Orange penalty this turn; discard 1 resource
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

red.name: Red Deck - Escalation Layer
red.backArt: Fiery red shield with crossed swords and flaming gem (page 29)

cards.title: Burning Crossing
cards.effectText: Bridges here lose 1 durability at end of each round
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects bridges built here

cards.title: Siege Grounds
cards.effectText: Walls around this tile cannot be repaired
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects all walls adjacent to it

cards.title: Sabotaged Foundations
cards.effectText: Build here costs +2 resource
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects all teams who build here

cards.title: Fractured Border
cards.effectText: Structures here take +1 durability damage when damaged
cards.scopeText: This card affects all infrastructures here
cards.notes: Printed scope has typo 'infastructures'.

cards.title: Warpath Corridor
cards.effectText: Movement through this tile costs +1 action
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects any team on this tile

cards.title: Wild Predator Grounds
cards.effectText: Build a wall or lose 1 resource if team ends turn here
cards.scopeText: This card affects every team on this terrain
cards.notes: Printed scope missing the word 'affects'.

cards.title: Collapsing Outpost
cards.effectText: If a structure here reaches 1 durability, remove it
cards.scopeText: Affects ALL infrastructure around this tile

cards.title: Ember Field
cards.effectText: If any team stands here, ALL teams' production is reduced by 1
cards.scopeText: This card affects ALL teams globally

cards.title: Occupied Territory
cards.effectText: Only 1 team may end their turn here
cards.scopeText: This card activates when a Team is on this tile

cards.title: Forced Evacuation Zone
cards.effectText: Choose ANY team on the map to retreat 1 hex
cards.scopeText: Card activates when ANY team is on this tile

cards.title: Control Point
cards.effectText: Team with the most Supply gains 1 Supply
cards.scopeText: This card only affects ONCE

cards.title: Contested Grounds
cards.effectText: If 2 or more teams are here, ALL teams lose 1 action
cards.scopeText: This card activates when 2 Teams are present

cards.title: Strategic Chokepoint
cards.effectText: Pay 1 of ANY resource to enter this tile
cards.scopeText: This effect activates each time a TEAM enters
cards.notes: Title on asset list was 'Strategic Checkpoint'; print reads 'Chokepoint'.

cards.title: Hostile Occupation
cards.effectText: If you leave this tile, lose 1 durability on one structure on the map
cards.scopeText: This card only affects YOU

cards.title: Resource Blockade
cards.effectText: All teams halt production for 1 round
cards.scopeText: Affects everyone EXCEPT the team on this tile

cards.title: Taxed Stronghold
cards.effectText: Build and Upgrade here cost +1 action
cards.scopeText: This card only affects team on this tile

cards.title: Rampaging Beasts
cards.effectText: ALL walls lose 1 durability here, lose 1 Supply if no wall is built
cards.scopeText: This card affects ANY team on this tile

cards.title: Ruptured Pipeline
cards.effectText: If no Wall is built here, production is reduced by 1
cards.scopeText: This card affects ANY team on this tile

cards.title: Scorched Earth
cards.effectText: Disable a tile anywhere on the map from construction permanently
cards.scopeText: Tile effect activates when a Team is present

cards.title: Civil Unrest
cards.effectText: If 2 or more Red tiles are adjacent at end of round, remove 1 resource from each team
cards.scopeText: This card affects teams when criteria are met

cards.title: Infrastructure Collapse
cards.effectText: All structures around this tile lose 1 durability immediately
cards.scopeText: The terrain effect activates when the first team enters

cards.title: Open Rebellion
cards.effectText: When explored, all teams discard 1 resource
cards.scopeText: Tile effect activates when a Team explores it

cards.title: Border Skirmish
cards.effectText: If no Wall is built on this tile, all structures within a radius of 2 tiles lose 1 durability
cards.scopeText: The terrain effect activates when the team is present and no walls are built

cards.title: Werewolf Sighting
cards.effectText: Any team present must build 1 Wall immediately OR lose all their resources
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects any TEAM present here

cards.title: Defensive Standoff
cards.effectText: Teams here may take only 1 action
cards.scopeText: This terrain affects all teams on this tile

cards.title: Earthquake
cards.effectText: All structures on board lose 1 durability; if any structure loses all durability, remove it
cards.scopeText: Effect activates when team discards the card
cards.notes: Footer: This is an action card, do not put this on the map.

cards.title: Typhoon
cards.effectText: All bridges lose 1 durability and movement everywhere costs +1 action this round
cards.scopeText: Effect activates when team discards the card
cards.notes: Footer: This is an action card, do not put this on the map.

cards.title: Plague Outbreak
cards.effectText: Each team must discard 2 resources of your choice
cards.scopeText: Effect activates when team discards the card
cards.notes: Footer: This is an action card, do not put this on the map.

endgame.name: End Game Deck
endgame.backArt: Glowing stone question mark on fiery background (page 10)
endgame.accessRule: Spend 1 Supply to draw 1 card; resolve immediately (Hub P1).

cards.title: Golden Gate
cards.notes: No printed text - resolution is by rulebook: Collaborative = victory; Competitive = triggers final resolution (Hub P1). Bright portal atop mountain with angel statues.

cards.title: Decoy
cards.notes: Dark ruined-fortress mirror of the Golden Gate artwork. No printed text - no effect (dead draw), pending creator confirmation.

cards.title: Wild Wolves
cards.effectText: Build a wall OR lose 2 resources
cards.scopeText: This effect affects any TEAM beside here

cards.title: Barbarians
cards.effectText: Build a wall OR lose 2 resources
cards.scopeText: This effect affects any TEAM beside here
cards.notes: Resolves the handoff doc's 'blank raider card' question: printed effect is identical to Wild Wolves.

RESOLVED 2026-07-14 - OR27/OR30: badge value is '-1'; printed '+1 cost' effect text stands.
RESOLVED 2026-07-14 - GR04 wording variants: play as printed.
